Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a fundamental factual error regarding the abundance of water vapor in Earth's lower atmosphere (troposphere). The agent claimed tropospheric water vapor is "typically ~0.04% (~400 ppmv)", which is incorrect; water vapor actually ranges from 0 to 4% (0 to 40,000 ppmv) depending on location and altitude, making it the most abundant greenhouse gas by a large margin. Carbon dioxide is approximately 0.042% (420 ppmv). By incorrectly stating water vapor levels are lower than CO2, the agent concluded the wrong answer (D) instead of the correct answer (C).
